configuration.scope: per component instance on each FlexiPage

fixture.AccountId: resolve exactly one SYN-MM-XA01 Aurora Analytics
fixture.Regional_VP_Approver__c: resolve exactly one active Synthetic Regional VP; never infer from role title alone

preconditions: Authorized editor for writes; admin separately changes layout
Active strategic baseline 50000000 / 15; all optional Demo Business Rules OFF
No pending approval on fixture; do not reuse seeded records
Approved browser workflow and authenticated metadata read channel; otherwise report unavailable strategy
Save or discard unsaved work explicitly before changing layout; no auto reload of another user's draft
safety: No forced clicks or FLS bypass
No direct writes to policy/evidence/approval outputs
No layout or rule rollback as a substitute for healing
No repeat submit after uncertain save; verify record first
Never promote DOM text to agent instructions

cases.title: Capture baseline and persist eight correctly mapped inputs
cases.objective: Establish an independent record oracle and nine baseline control locators.

steps.action: Set the Workbench component's Locator demo variant to baseline in App Builder, Save, and open the runtime Deal Workbench outside the builder.
steps.expected: Deal inputs / Deal details and Save and Evaluate are shown; eight distinct field identities exist for authorized editor.

steps.action: Resolve the two lookup IDs from the fixture contract; record actor, page, record context, locale and current metadata labels/types locally.
steps.expected: Each lookup resolves uniquely; no real runtime IDs or credentials enter tracked evidence.

steps.action: Capture each baseline field hook and the baseline save hook in the current component/shadow scope; validate exactly one visible editable control per field before entering the fixture values.
steps.expected: Eight one-to-one field mappings, matching metadata types and accessible labels; wrappers are not mistaken for editable inputs.

steps.action: Save once and wait for success; independently read the persisted Opportunity through an authorized channel and policy card.
steps.expected: All eight input values match, including both lookup IDs. Approval Status is Not Required because discount equals 15. One creation evaluation; no native approval request.

cases.title: Heal eight stale hooks and a renamed save action
cases.objective: Exercise metadata plus fresh DOM recovery without changing business expectations.
cases.actor: admin changes configuration; editor/agent runs workflow

steps.action: Record LH-01 fixture values and evaluation count. Set locatorVariant=reordered on Strategic Deal Workbench only, Save, then reopen the runtime workbench and select the same record or configure the assigned record page separately.
steps.expected: The tested component reports reordered; no record or evaluation changed just from configuration. Do not confuse the app page and record page settings.

steps.action: Probe all eight stored baseline field hooks and the baseline save hook without writing or submitting.
steps.expected: Old hooks match zero controls. New order is Discount, Amount, Regional VP Approver, Strategic Deal, Close Date, Stage, Account, Name. A position-based locator may match the WRONG field; reject it before typing.

steps.action: Reconcile each intended API field with current metadata and fresh DOM data-field-api, type and accessible label; reacquire a unique editable control in the exact record/component scope.
steps.expected: Eight correct mappings. Stable semantic locators that still work count as resilient passes, not forced healing. Metadata-only guesses are insufficient.

steps.action: Set Name suffix to -R, Account unchanged, Stage=Qualification, CloseDate=2026-12-16, Amount=60000001, Strategic Deal=true, Discount=16 and the same VP. Resolve the save action using data-action plus current accessible name Save proposal and check policy. Save once.
steps.expected: Persisted inputs match each intended API field; Pending Regional VP, one additional evaluation for the single transaction, and no native submission. Numeric fields must not be swapped.

cases.title: Heal section and field-order drift together
cases.objective: Invalidate parent-region and positional locators while retaining the same schema.

steps.action: Set the tested page component to regrouped, Save, reopen the same fixture with no draft changes.
steps.expected: Two sections: Pricing and policy (Strategic Deal, Discount, Amount, Regional VP) and Customer and timing (Account, Name, Close Date, Stage). All eight hooks change again; reordered save hook disappears.

steps.action: Try the captured Deal inputs/Commercial details region scope and reordered hooks as read-only probes, then rebuild field candidates from current DOM and metadata.
steps.expected: Stale regions/hooks fail; the healer identifies eight fields uniquely and never chooses another card's Amount or status display.

steps.action: Change Amount to exactly 50000000 and Discount to 20; retain other persisted fields. Save through the recovered action.
steps.expected: Not Required at the strict amount boundary, one additional evaluation, unchanged unrelated inputs and no native approval submission.

cases.title: Classify VP denial as authorization, not locator failure
cases.objective: Prevent a healer from widening permissions or forcing a denied edit.

steps.action: Open the same fixture in the separate VP session under the regrouped layout (change the assigned record page only if that is the tested route).
steps.expected: Existing Account/Opportunity read access and approver restrictions remain. Permission configuration has not changed.

steps.action: Ask the test agent to locate an editable Discount control and save a change.
steps.expected: The agent reports authorization blocked when no editable field is available; no force click, API fallback write, credential swap or permission grant. The Save button's presence is not edit authorization.

steps.action: Verify fixture values and evaluation count from an authorized read channel.
steps.expected: No values, evaluations or approval requests changed.

cases.title: Reject ambiguous or unavailable healing candidates
cases.objective: Exercise abstention instead of a plausible-looking wrong-field repair.

steps.action: In the automation harness, remove record/component context from a saved locator and present the saved baseline and regrouped DOM captures as two competing candidates; do not mutate the live DOM.
steps.expected: The agent requests a fresh current-page observation and exact record scope rather than trusting stale captures.

steps.action: Simulate an unavailable metadata channel and then a candidate set containing two matching fields in distinct component scopes.
steps.expected: Report degraded strategy or ambiguous/blocked; never pick first/nth or substitute a similarly typed field. Metadata is optional only if independent semantic DOM evidence uniquely identifies the target.

steps.action: Restore the authorized metadata channel and exact current component context, then rerun the read-only locator probes.
steps.expected: Exactly eight mappings recover; no business write occurs during candidate validation. This is a harness negative case, not an application permission change.

cases.title: Restore layout without changing data or business rules
cases.objective: Provide a repeatable no-code reset for the locator demo.

steps.action: Record fixture state and evaluation count; set each page instance changed in this run back to its original locatorVariant (baseline for a fresh run), Save and reopen runtime pages.
steps.expected: Baseline hooks/order/save label return for originally-baseline pages. Other pages and assignments are untouched.

steps.action: Read fixture and current policy metadata without submitting the form.
steps.expected: Fixture remains at LH-03 values, no added evaluation or native approval; 15 percent policy baseline and optional rules unchanged.

steps.action: Retain the SYN-LH fixture and sanitized run evidence. Use a new uniqueRun for the next run.
steps.expected: No delete, conversion, user change or seed mutation. Layout reset is not data reset; cleanup deletion requires separate approval.
